annual_api_reconciliation.full_regression: 2021 passed in61.28s; source audit193 successful calls across39 policies,133 unique source records,0 unresolved. Coverage is observed calculations, not full legal/business acceptance.
annual_api_reconciliation.scope: Thai-incorporated resident ordinary-rate company, calendar2026, final verified expense bases, no exemptions or carried losses, RD300 election only. Computes country credit and reconciles every foreign country to saved gross receipts, paid tax and annual expenses. Rejects credited amounts also included in expense deductions.
annual_api_reconciliation.validation: 34 focused calculation/API/report tests passed in 5.70s, including persisted reopening, request replay, bilingual report snapshots and rejected double deduction without state mutation.
annual_api_reconciliation.synthetic_royalty_case: Domestic income2000000 + foreign royalty1000000, final annual expenses600000 including50000 uncredited foreign tax, foreign tax250000, RD300 credit200000, gross Thai tax480000, final280000, prepaid300000, balance-20000THB.
annual_api_reconciliation.limits: Does not infer expense eligibility, maximize deductions, choose treaty versus RD300 or derive SME limits. Frontend workpaper entry is not yet implemented. Broad business acceptance remains incomplete.

component_validation.scope: Ordinary 20% country limit workpaper; combined versus separate clause4 treatment, no cross-country pooling, loss floor, evidence and classification rejection.
component_validation.not_supported: Annual settlement, excess-tax expense feedback, SME allocation, saved-case UI/report. Component is not registered as an annual assessment policy.

annual_path_review.finding: Ruling0706/10858 paragraphs1-3 addresses service-company facts: uncredited difference may be deductible under treaty and RD300 paths; method may be elected per country per accounting period. Treaty and RD300 are distinct elections, not automatically interchangeable.
annual_path_review.return_finding: Separate treaty credit and RD300 exemption lines. Treaty credit description uses attributable Thai-tax proportion; RD300 refers to Notification65 country calculation.
annual_path_review.unresolved: No numeric primary-source example resolving business-net excess-expense feedback or SME allocation established. Annual integration still pending; do not infer a uniform treaty/RD300 formula.

period_allocation_component.test_result: 64 passed in 2.83s across period allocation, country limits, existing Thai company reconciliation and Thai rate tests
period_allocation_component.rules: Notification65 clauses7-9: use actual profit or gross-receipt share in overlapping periods and market FX at foreign tax payment; later payment can require amendment of the income-period return.
period_allocation_component.validation: Reject disjoint/reversed periods, zero denominator, overlap above total, incomplete full-period allocation, invalid FX and unverified evidence. Preserve exact fraction, unknown filing state and input timing in result.
period_allocation_component.scope: Positive foreign assessment basis with nonnegative overlap; loss-containing apportionment needs separate review. This supplies paid tax before country limits, not annual tax.

current_gap: Annual API can reconcile optional RD300 final expense workpapers. UI entry, automatic expense/election workflow, treaty and SME cases remain incomplete; original manually established-credit path remains available.
verified_rules: Decree300 applies to Thai-established companies,with paid-tax evidence and no deduction of the credited amount.

Notification65 clauses3-4 distinguish foreign-business net income and foreign-company receipts; same-country mixed cases have combination/separation conditions. Do not automatically reuse personal gross-allocation or Indonesian country/type logic.

Ruling0702/8746 permits the unrelieved difference as an expense in the income-accrual period for its stated royalty facts; later foreign payment requires amending that income year. Do not label all excess nondeductible.
next_steps: Add frontend RD300 country workpaper entry and browser business cases to the existing annual API/report.
Resolve automatic excess-tax expense derivation and SME allocation; current annual adapter requires verified final expense inputs.
Add treaty-path elections without conflating them with RD300 limits.
limits: Annual API/report support verified final-expense RD300 workpapers only. Treaty/SME and automatic expense eligibility remain incomplete; case-specific rulings must not be generalized beyond supported facts.

notification65: Clause7 uses market exchange rate on foreign-tax payment date.
Clause8 apportions mismatched foreign periods by profit or gross receipts depending on the foreign tax base.
Clause9 requires correcting the original return after later foreign payment; clause10 retains the elected treatment within that period.
Clause11 requires certified payment evidence with Thai/English translation and taxpayer,income,tax details.
timing_and_evidence_review.remaining: Resolve numeric excess-expense feedback and graduated SME limits; do not substitute average-rate allocation without evidence.
